user.title: Choose country
user.description: Choose a country. The next steps load matching regions, cities, and local areas from online location services.

region.title: Choose region
region.description: Choose a broad region. The next step narrows to a county or sub-region.

city.title: Choose city
city.description: Cities and towns are narrowed to the selected county where supported.

area.title: Choose local area
area.description: Neighbourhoods and districts are looked up from OpenStreetMap. The local area is optional. You can also enter a Ticketmaster API key.

county.title: Choose county or sub-region
county.description: Choose a county or local sub-region within the selected region, or skip this level where county data is unavailable.

init.title: Choose country
init.description: Choose a country, then select from its online region, city, and area lists.

city.title: Choose city
city.description: Cities and towns are narrowed to the selected county where supported.

area.title: Choose local area
area.description: Choose an available neighbourhood or district, or skip this level.

county.title: Choose county or sub-region
county.description: Choose a county or local sub-region within the selected region, or skip this level where county data is unavailable.
